description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Fang (Dragoon)]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Fang (Dragoon)
description.text: Increases [Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Dragoon abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Fang (Dragoon) after using using three Dragoon abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Whirlwind+
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (1.05 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Aerial Loop+
description.text: Four single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Jump Instant Cast] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Fang (Dragoon)
description.text: Grants [Dragoon Instant Cast 2] and [Dragoon +30% Boost 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
